# Release <identifier>

Status: proposed / validated candidate / authorized / deployed / rolled back
Candidate SHA and included feature heads:
Target, operator and explicit authorization reference:
Build inputs/artifact hashes; generator/protocol/save/schema versions:

## Scope and compatibility

Player-visible changes, known exclusions, data/client compatibility, migration
order and fallback. Link exact source, asset and independent review evidence.

## Checks actually run

Unit/build, database, browser/input, physical departure/return, visual/hardware,
soak, SMTP and restore tests as applicable. State pass/fail/skip with environment
and owner. No checked box may stand for a test that did not run.

## Deployment and verification

Time, exact deployed identity, service health/API/WS and player entry checks.
Authorization for a candidate is not proof it deployed. Keep credentials out.

## Recovery

Previous compatible release, data considerations, tested backup/restore, rollback
steps/owner and success checks. Do not blindly reverse migrations or shared history.
